arguments.sql: SELECT j.jrnl_no, SUM(j.dr_amt) AS dr, SUM(j.cr_amt) AS cr, SUM(j.dr_amt)-SUM(j.cr_amt) AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" j GROUP BY j.jrnl_no HAVING ABS(SUM(j.dr_amt)-SUM(j.cr_amt)) > 0.005 ORDER BY j.jrnl_no
SELECT inv_id, vend_cd, inv_no, inv_amt, stat_cd, jrnl_no FROM "APINVH" WHERE inv_amt < 0 OR jrnl_no IS NULL OR jrnl_no NOT IN (SELECT jrnl_no FROM "GLJRNH")
SELECT LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(inv_no)),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') AS n, UPPER(TRIM(vend_cd)) AS v, COUNT(*) AS c, ARRAY_AGG(inv_id) AS ids FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT i.inv_id, i.inv_amt, a.pay_total, i.stat_cd FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN (SELECT inv_id, SUM(pay_amt) AS pay_total FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY inv_id) a ON a.inv_id=i.inv_id WHERE (i.stat_cd='P' AND ABS(COALESCE(a.pay_total,0)-i.inv_amt)>0.005) OR (i.stat_cd='O' AND a.pay_total IS NOT NULL) OR COALESCE(a.pay_total,0)>i.inv_amt + 0.005
